key.name: last-vault
key.description: URI of the vault folder to open on start, empty for none.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Whether the app follows the system style or is always light or dark.

key.name: notes-sort
key.description: Whether notes are listed by when they were last edited or by name.

key.name: notes-group-by-project
key.description: Whether the notes page shows the notes of all projects under a heading per project.

key.name: assets-sort
key.description: Whether the files of a project are listed by name, by when they were last edited or by when they were added. Folders always come first.

key.name: block-panel-width
key.description: How wide the panel with the block shown in the day view is at most, as dragged at its edge.
